agyos_skill.intent: Resume Writer. Rewrites your resume for each role so it reads like the job description, using only what is true: it mirrors the posting's own words for skills you really have, moves buried results into strong bullets (a number, a strong verb, one line), reorders for the role, and asks you about anything the posting wants that the resume does not show. Scores the match from 0 to 100 with a published formula (minimum qualifications, preferred qualifications, bullet strength, sections) and runs a truth check that fails if the rewrite adds a number or a skill that was not in your original. Use when the user says \
